_comment: AI drivers (card 05). cornerMargin = fraction of the computed safe corner speed it uses; brakeMargin = fraction of its estimated max braking it plans with (lower = brakes earlier); lookahead = baseM + perMps x speed; steerKp = gain on the pure-pursuit wheel angle (1 = geometric), steerKd = damping on heading-error change; noise = random steer jitter; mistakesPerMin = chance of a late brake or a wide line; traffic = forward cone and overtaking offset. pits: stop when fuel < fuelLaps laps or any tyre < minWear; drive the pit lane pitSpeedMarginKph under the limit; with Realistic damage, pit for repair once any zone is past repairDamage. recovery.resetAfterSec: still crawling or stuck this long (reverse-outs not getting it going) -> reset to track like a player, same penalty. start: reaction to lights out, random in min..max per driver. aids: traction control on the rears' slip, as a fraction of peak (03b); trail*: steering more than trailSteer and over its target speed, the AI brakes in proportion to the overspeed (full trailMaxPedal at trailOverspeedMps) instead of a firm 30%+, so the unloaded inside front doesn't lock. traffic.sideGapM: lateral gap kept to a car alongside beyond the cars' width (3-wide is fine if it fits); giving way to a car that has itself (nearly) stopped, it crawls on at crawlMps rather than wait for good. pitLane: through the lane it keeps fastLaneM off the pit path away from the boxes (single file, no passing; it follows only a car in its lane, within its width + laneGapM, and ignores cars parked in boxes), moves across into its own box boxApproachM before it at latRateMps, and waits in the box until the lane is clear releaseGapM back; stopped behind a car that's stopped short of the lane (waiting for it in turn) it creeps on at creepMps (contact.json pitLaneGhosting lets pit-lane cars pass through each other). skill.spread: how far a roster driver's PACE stat (config/drivers.json) moves its corner and braking margins (+-spread at pace 0 / 100); the roster's other stats set mistakes, noise, tyre care, aggression and racecraft. racecraft (AI racecraft card): three lines, NEUTRAL (the racing line), EXIT (through a corner before at least exitStraightM of straight, the line re-optimised through it and exitShiftM past it with the exit's curvature weighted exitWeight x the entry's: a later apex) and INSIDE (insideM toward the inside from insideLeadM before a corner to its apex, edgeM from the edge), picked by a mode re-evaluated every evalSec and held at least holdSec: ATTACK (car ahead within attackGapSec and closing, or in its tow: EXIT before a straight, else NEUTRAL: INSIDE proved slower), DEFEND (car behind within defendGapSec closing: NEUTRAL, plus deploy), NURSE (average tyre below nurseWear or damage past nurseDamage), MANAGE (else: NEUTRAL). Lines blend at blendPerM of a full change per metre; during a blend the slower line's speed counts. overtaking (AI overtaking card): attacking, it closes right up out of corners: a car length + 1.5 m + attackHeadwaySec x (1.5 - aggression) s of headway, back to the full 0.35 s from closeUntilBrakeSec before a braking point, and plans its braking at attackFollowBrake x (just following: 0.8 x); pulled out and closing within commitM it commits to the move: keeps that side until past, aborts if the car gets more than commitM away or it isn't alongside (1.5 car lengths) by the corner; in a tow, pull out pullOutSec + aggression x pullOutAggrSec before the braking point; overlap rule: side by side within overlapM lengthwise with a corner coming, the car on the inside has the right of way (else the car ahead does), and the other leaves it room, dropping just under its speed when there's no room for both; a defender with aggression below concedeBelow lifts for a car overlapped on its inside into a braking zone; blue flags: a car blueLaps or more ahead in the race always has the right of way, and once it's pulled out alongside (within blueBehindM behind) on a straight the lapped car holds its line and lifts blueLift. coast: lift and coast for small speed drops (<= coastMaxDropMps, above coastMinKph, within 1.5 s) instead of braking, and lift liftBeforeBrakeSec before a braking zone. Tune by racing them (panel: T).
